{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if recent history shows persistent downward drift after a peak, regardless of sentiment.",
    "Apply a mild upward bias correction when sentiment is positive and model underperforms (e.g., misses upward momentum).",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term sentiment swings; maintain long-term mean-reversion bias unless sentiment is strongly divergent.",
    "Downscale forecasts when sentiment is negative and historical mean is above current price — avoid bullish overcorrection.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or slightly negative — anticipate mean reversion.",
    "Apply a lag correction: if model forecasts are too high 3–5 days ahead, reduce by 5–10% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "When sentiment is positive but model underperforms, consider adding a 2–3% upward adjustment to capture sentiment-driven momentum."
  ]
}
